jobs.description:
Employee Type: 
Fixed Term (Fixed Term) 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department: 
 The Fund Development department aims to develop and implement strategies to increase the funding income of Islamic Relief through a range of fundraising initiatives and through the acquisition and retention of donors, volunteers and  community supporters 

 Job Purpose: 
 This position will work directly under the Regional FD Manager. He/she will be responsible for supporting the fulfillment of the organizational objectives of developing and optimising on community fundraising and volunteer initiatives  
 This position will be the point of contact and representative of IRC with their regional volunteer teams. 
 
 Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 
 Community Relations Maintain existing donor relationships and partnerships with a focus on an allocated area within the region   
 Explore and develop new relationships and partnerships with the goal of widening the community outreach and increasing the number of new donors to Islamic Relief   
 Manage the stakeholder relationships by holding regular meetings, providing feedback on donations and exploring what Islamic Relief can offer them

 Set up fundraisers at mosques and in the community to raise funds and awareness  
 
 Meet fundraising targets and ensure return on investment is met with individuals and/or networks we partner with   
 Formalize partnerships with individuals and networks by following the necessary protocols i.e. establishing a Memorandum of Understanding or contracts   
 Provide fundraising support to stakeholders working with Islamic Relief  
 Respond to fundraising and other inquiries in relation to regional activities 
 Communicate performance and provide regular updates to Line Manager 
 Utilize all regional and personal social media platforms to promote Islamic Relief messaging, campaigns, activities and appeals 
 
 Volunteers and Networking Build a regional volunteer team by recruiting, training and managing members 
 Lead the regional volunteer team in planning and executing grass roots community events 
 Lead regional volunteer team in executing larger IRC events, challenges and tours 
 Assist with any fundraising activities taking place in the region 
 Lead volunteer team to promote and obtain attendance at or with all IRC fundraising events and initiatives 
 Attend and network at local and IRC events to build relationships, recruit for new volunteers  
 
 Event Planning and Execution Lead regional volunteer teams in managing events locally or event participation in consultation with line manager   
 Represent the organization at IR and non-IR events

 About the Department:
jobs.description:
Employee Type: 
Permanent 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department:  
 Join our dynamic Marketing Department, where creativity meets purpose. Our team is dedicated to crafting compelling campaigns and content that inspire and engage our community. We strive to amplify our mission, drive donor engagement, and create meaningful impact through innovative strategies and storytelling. 

 Job Purpose:  
 Reporting to the Digital Marketing Manager, the Website and Digital Experience Specialist is responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of Islamic Relief Canada’s (IRC) website and digital products, ensuring content accuracy, functionality, and brand consistency.  
   
 This role combines technical expertise with strategic insight to optimize user experience, improve search visibility, and enhance digital engagement across all Islamic Relief Canada web products. The Website & Digital Experience Specialist will work closely with the marketing and technology teams to ensure the website and related products remain effective, user-friendly, and reflective of IRC’s brand identity. 
  
 Essential Duties & Responsibilities:  
    
 1. Website Operations & Content Management  
 Oversee daily operations of the website, ensuring all content is accurate, functional, and up to date. 
 Collaborate with content creators and designers to update landing pages, campaign pages, and other digital assets. 
 Ensure all web products and assets reflect brand guidelines, tone of voice, and organizational priorities. 
 Coordinate with internal teams to publish content that supports fundraising, campaigns, and donor engagement. 
  
 2. User Experience & Optimization  
 Analyze user behavior and site performance to identify pain points and opportunities for improvement 
 Use analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Search Console, heatmaps) to track and report on website performance 
 Recommend and implement enhancements to improve user engagement, navigation, and conversions 
 Collaborate with the Technology team to improve usability, speed, and accessibility 
 Lead A/B testing on landing pages and content to optimize conversion rates 
  
 3. SEO & Search Visibility  
 Conduct keyword research and monitor SEO trends to maintain a competitive edge 
 Implement on-page and technical SEO strategies to improve search engine rankings 
 Provide insights and recommendations for content optimization based on search data and user trends 
 Stay ahead of evolving discovery channels by monitoring how AI-driven platforms (e.g., LLMs, chat-based search, and answer engines) surface and interpret organizational content 
 Develop strategies to optimize IRC’s digital presence and content for visibility in AI-generated responses and emerging search paradigms 
  
 4. Innovation/R&D:   
 Monitor emerging web and digital experience trends to ensure IRC remains innovative and sector-leading 
 Pilot and test innovative digital approaches that enhance supporter engagement, storytelling, and fundraising impact…

 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department:  
 Join our dynamic Marketing Department, where creativity meets purpose. Our team is dedicated to crafting compelling campaigns and content that inspire and engage our community. We strive to amplify our mission, drive donor engagement, and create meaningful impact through innovative strategies and storytelling. 

 Applications submitted without a portfolio will not be considered. 
 Applicants must submit a portfolio of recent video and graphic design work as part of their application. The portfolio should include examples of content the candidate has created or contributed to, such as social media posts (reels, carousels, graphics).  
 
 Job Purpose:   
 The Social Media Content Creator (GTA) plays a key role in supporting the Social Media Manager to drive the content calendar, execute digital priorities, and create timely, engaging content that connects audiences to our work and impact. 

 This role combines creativity, storytelling, and digital expertise, with a strong focus on trend-responsive content, social-first photo and video production, and on-the-ground coverage of events and activities across the GTA. You will also contribute to data-informed content planning and ensures a consistent, high-quality, and brand-aligned presence across all our social media platforms. 

 The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and creative thinker with a sharp eye for detail, a proactive approach to content creation, and the ability to turn ideas, moments, and stories into compelling digital experiences. 

 Essential Duties & Responsibilities:  

 Trend Monitoring & Creative Adaptation   Monitor emerging social media trends, formats, and platform updates on a daily basis. 
 Develop rapid‑turnaround content concepts based on relevant trends that align with Islamic Relief's brand voice and campaign goals. 
 Test new formats and creative approaches with the Social Media team. 
 Maintain weekly trend summaries to guide content planning. 
 
 
 Event & Staff Content Production    Capture high‑quality in‑office, staff, and event‑based content. 
 Film and photograph staff, visitors, and community engagements. 
 Support content coverage across GTA and other regions as needed. 
 Edit and produce reels, TikToks, carousels, and short‑form videos. 
 Coordinate with internal teams to plan content needs for events and campaigns. 
 Maintain an organized library of photo/video assets. 
 
 
 Data Reporting & Performance Insights    Compile weekly analytics dashboards and support the Social Media Manager with monthly reporting. 
 Track audience growth, engagement patterns, and content performance. 
 Use Hootsuite to pull platform‑specific metrics, compare week‑over‑week changes, and identify performance trends. 
 Analyze reach, impressions, retention, watch‑time, click‑through rates, and follower behaviors to inform content decisions. 
 Identify high‑performing posts and recommend adjustments to improve results.…

jobs.title: Ramadan Donor Care Officer
jobs.description:
Job Description & Person Specification
 Ramadan Donor Care Officer - Ramadan 2027
 Salary: £12.80 per hour
 Contract: Temporary / Zero-Hour Contract - Ramadan 2027 Campaign
 Hours/Shifts: Rotational, variable shifts - minimum 3-4 days per week. Primary daytime shifts will typically run from 11:00 AM to 4:30 PM, with timings subject to adjustment throughout Ramadan in line with changing Maghrib (sunset) times and operational requirements (see details below).
 Location: Manchester M14 6AX (On-site)
 Reports to: Donor Care Team Leader / Donor Care Manager
 Recruitment Period: October - November 2026
 Onboarding: Late November - Early December 2026 (exact dates TBC) Mandatory Ramadan training dates: Sun 31st Jan & Sat 6th Feb 2027
 Ramadan Campaign: Approximately 8th February - 9th March 2027 (subject to moon sighting)
 We are unable to sponsor applicants for visas for this particular post. Applicants must be resident in the UK and have the Right to Work in the UK. 
 About READ Foundation
 READ Foundation is a UK-based registered charity working to provide access to quality education to vulnerable children in our regions of work. We create opportunities for orphan and needy children to go to school, gain an education and build a better life for themselves.
 We currently focus on constructing new schools, providing sponsorship for orphans and expanding our educational portfolio to reflect the significant humanitarian and development needs across the world.
 About Donor Care
 The Donor Care department at READ is essential to the organisation's success, fulfilling its role as the primary hub for customer service, donor retention and income generation.
 During Ramadan, Donor Care plays a particularly important role in strengthening relationships with existing donors, retaining Orphan Sponsorships and generating vital income for READ Foundation's charitable projects and appeals.
 Purpose of Job
 The Ramadan Donor Care Officer is a temporary, campaign-specific position recruited to support READ Foundation's Ramadan 2027 fundraising and donor-retention activities.
 The role is primarily focused on two key objectives:
 1. Donor Retention: Maximising Orphan Sponsorship renewals through proactive donor engagement, relationship management and outbound telephone calls.
 2. Income Generation: Raising vital funds through READ Foundation's Ramadan outbound fundraising campaign by engaging existing and prospective donors.
 Successful candidates will primarily be allocated to one of two teams:
 · Orphan Sponsorship Renewals Team 
 · Ramadan Outbound Fundraising Team 
 Some Officers may work across both functions or be selected to provide additional inbound donor support.
 Team allocations will be determined by management based on organisational priorities, individual competency, previous experience, training performance, productivity, attitude and operational requirements.
 Extensive training and ongoing support will be provided.
 Primary Ramadan Responsibilities
 1. Orphan Sponsorship Renewals & Retention…

jobs.title: Donor Relations Administrator
jobs.excerpt:
Employee Type: 
Seasonal (Fixed Term) (Seasonal) 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 A
jobs.description:
Employee Type: 
Seasonal (Fixed Term) (Seasonal) 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department: 
 Join our dedicated Donor Relations Department, where compassion and excellence drive our mission. Our team is responsible for ensuring donors' inquiries and requests are answered promptly and efficiently through various communication channels. We manage the orphan sponsorship program and oversee the stewardship of water wells, ensuring that our donors feel connected and valued.
 Our goal is to create an exceptional donor journey, bridging supporters to the right holders by sharing updates and reports on orphan sponsorship and water well projects, and processing their donations seamlessly. By fostering strong relationships and providing detailed updates, we strive to make each donor's experience fulfilling and impactful.
  
 Job Purpose: 
 Islamic Relief's objective is to build and maintain trust with our donors through transparency of our programs, educating them by answering any questions, and providing different options on how they can contribute to help vulnerable communities globally. This position is responsible for providing superior customer service to our donors by responding to incoming inquiries via phone and/or email, making outbound calls, and supporting our ongoing marketing campaigns. The hours for this role are between 9:00am - 5:00pm EST, Monday to Friday. However, a successful candidate for this position will be required to work overnight and flex hours on weekdays and weekends during our busy seasons, based on a scheduled shift rotation.
  
 Essential Duties & Responsibilities:  
 Respond promptly and professionally to donor inquiries via various channels, including phone calls, emails, and live chat.
 Process donor donations and refunds accurately and efficiently, adhering to established procedures and timelines.
 Strive to meet or exceed individual and team performance metrics, including response time and donor satisfaction ratings.
 Listen to voicemails and return calls.
 Collaborate with internal teams, such as Finance, Technical Support, and Fundraising, to respond to donor inquiries and requests, provide timely resolutions, and ensure a seamless donor experience.
 Contribute to various campaigns by processing donations on different platforms.
 Make chase calls post-events to process pledges.
 Perform any ad hoc tasks assigned by the donor relations manager and team leads
  
 Qualifications & Competencies 
 1-2 years of experience related to customer service and data management.
 Post-Secondary Education; University degree preferred.
 Proficiency in MS Excel is an asset.
 Proficiency with Gmail and select add-ons.
 Proficient (oral and written) in English and French (preferably).
 Ability to prioritize and reprioritize to meet donor needs, stay organized, and meet deadlines.
 Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills to assess donor needs and provide effective solutions.…

jobs.title: Regional Fundraising Manager - Ottawa/Quebec/Atlantic
jobs.excerpt:
Employee Type: 
Permanent 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department:
jobs.description:
Employee Type: 
Permanent 
 Become a changemaker with Islamic Relief Canada! Join our team and work towards our mission to mobilize Canadians to transform more lives around the world in the most trusted manner.
 
 
 About the Department: 
 The Fund Development department aims to develop and implement strategies to increase the funding income of Islamic Relief through a range of fundraising initiatives and through acquisition and retention of donors, volunteers and community supporters.  

 Job Purpose: 
 This position will work directly under the Head of National Community Fundraising. He/she will be responsible for developing and implementing a sustainable community fundraising strategy for their region in order to raise funds and increase awareness & participation amongst supporters.  
 This position will be the point of contact and representative of IRC in the assigned region. 
 This individual will need to develop a large network and work c­ollaboratively with key stakeholders including other departments internally, volunteers, community institutions and partners, to plan, deliver, and evaluate fundraising initiatives and maximize income generation opportunities. 
   
 Essential Duties & Responsibilities:  

 Manage Fundraising Team 
 Lead, manage and motivate a team of fundraisers to achieve the national fundraising strategy, providing clear guidelines, plans, and deliverables. 
 Ensure regular feedback is given to team members, issues and concerns highlighted, and remedial action is agreed and implemented. 
  Oversee the setting and implementation of objectives for direct reports and the regional fundraising team as a whole, aligned to the organisation's strategy and departments' work plans. 
 Carry out regular 1:1 meetings and annual appraisals and actively performance manage staff. 
 Ensure the regional team understand and adhere to the policies and procedures as directed 
 
 Community Relations 
 Identify and develop partnerships with local organizations, mosques and institutions to promote and support the work of Islamic Relief Canada 
 Meet with boards and other key stakeholders to establish a partnership with IRC 
 Scope and identify sponsorship opportunities in the region to build IRC presence, support from local partners and engagement with the community 
 
 Event Planning and Execution 
 Liaise with national events manager to plan for IRC events and speaker tours  
 Delegate implementation of events to regional fundraising team to ensure smooth roll out of each event/tour in the region and to meet set fundraising targets 
 Leverage relationships with mosques, community partners and key donors to sell tickets to events ensuring their success 
 
 Volunteers and Networking 
 Create local networks of supporters across the region that can deliver benefits for Islamic Relief including income, increasing profile and engagement 
 Travel within the region to meet and build relationships with key premium donors to enhance fundraising efforts…

 About the Department     

 The People and Culture Department at Islamic Relief Canada strives to create a work environment that fosters collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and excellence. We are dedicated to building a positive and productive workplace culture where employees feel valued , supported , and equipped to contribute effectively.   

   

 We support core  people functions, including recruitment and onboarding, employee relations and engagement, training and development, performance management, and compliance with labour laws and regulations. By joining our team, you will be part of a collaborative and supportive environment where your contributions directly  impact on  the well-being and success of our staff, enabling us to better serve communities in need.    
 

 Job Purpose     

 As an HR Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the People & Culture department and ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of core HR functions. Reporting to the Senior Manager, People & Culture, you will support HR administration, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, and compliance across the employee lifecycle. This is an additional role created to strengthen the department's capacity as IRC continues to grow and scale its people programs.    

 The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of HR best practices, hands-on experience with HR systems (Workday), excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.    

   

 Job Duties & Responsibilities     

 HR Operations     

 Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement and innovation within HR operations   

 
 Administer HR policies and procedures to ensure organizational consistency and compliance.   

 
 Manage employee benefits, including enrollment, updates, and related inquiries.    

 
 Oversee contract renewals and updates in a timely and accurate manner.    

 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records.    

 
 Provide guidance and support to employees on HR-related inquiries, issues, and concerns.   

 
 Assist with the development and implementation of HR initiatives, programs, and policies that support IRC's strategic objectives, and handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity   

 
 Support a workplace culture that is safe, inclusive, accountable, and in line with the organization's mission, vision, values and humanitarian purpose .
